panels.title: Analyses per day by outcome
panels.description: done / error-interrupted (message = "interrupted by a restart") / error-other / running, by day the analysis started.

targets.rawSql:
select $__timeGroup(started, '1d') as time,
  case
    when data->>'status' = 'done' then 'done'
    when data->>'status' = 'running' then 'running'
    when data->>'status' = 'error' and coalesce(data->>'message','') = 'interrupted by a restart' then 'error-interrupted'
    when data->>'status' = 'error' then 'error-other'
    else 'other'
  end as outcome,
  count(*) as count
from public.analyses
where $__timeFilter(started)
group by 1, 2
order by 1

panels.title: Success rate (done ÷ finished)
panels.description: Finished = status done or error, over the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
select
  case when count(*) filter (where data->>'status' in ('done','error')) = 0 then null
  else count(*) filter (where data->>'status' = 'done')::float8 / count(*) filter (where data->>'status' in ('done','error'))
  end as success_rate
from public.analyses
where $__timeFilter(started)

select $__timeGroup(started, '1d') as time,
  case when count(*) filter (where data->>'status' in ('done','error')) = 0 then null
  else count(*) filter (where data->>'status' = 'done')::float8 / count(*) filter (where data->>'status' in ('done','error'))
  end as success_rate
from public.analyses
where $__timeFilter(started)
group by 1
order by 1

select coalesce(data->>'message', '(no message)') as message,
  count(*) as count,
  max(started) as last_seen
from public.analyses
where data->>'status' = 'error' and $__timeFilter(started)
group by 1
order by count desc
limit 20

panels.title: Failed sources by reason
panels.description: Buckets the message of each "failed" stage: no open-access PDF, not found, timeout, other.

targets.rawSql:
select
  case
    when message ilike '%no open-access pdf%' then 'no open-access PDF'
    when message ilike '%no paper found%' then 'not found'
    when message ilike '%timed out%' or message ilike '%timeout%' then 'timeout'
    else 'other'
  end as reason,
  count(*) as count
from (
  select elem->>'message' as message
  from public.analyses a, lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(a.data->'stages', '[]'::jsonb)) elem
  where elem->>'stage' = 'failed' and $__timeFilter(a.started)
) f
group by 1
order by count desc

panels.title: Duration of finished runs (minutes)
panels.description: p50/p95 per day, first stage "at" to last stage "at", for runs that ended done or error. Rows with no "at" timestamps are excluded.

targets.rawSql:
with s as (
  select id, started, data,
    (select min((elem->>'at')::double precision) from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(data->'stages', '[]'::jsonb)) elem where elem ? 'at') as first_at,
    (select max((elem->>'at')::double precision) from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(data->'stages', '[]'::jsonb)) elem where elem ? 'at') as last_at
  from public.analyses
  where data->>'status' in ('done', 'error') and $__timeFilter(started)
)
select $__timeGroup(started, '1d') as time,
  percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (last_at - first_at) / 60.0) as "p50",
  percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by (last_at - first_at) / 60.0) as "p95"
from s
where first_at is not null and last_at is not null and last_at > first_at
group by 1
order by 1

panels.title: Time split per run (approximate, minutes)
panels.description: Approximation: reading = first stage → "planned"; source prep + judging = "planned" → last "verified"; finishing = last "verified" → "done". Averaged per day. Relies on stage "at" timestamps, which some older runs lack for some stages — those runs are simply skipped for the split(s) they are missing.

targets.rawSql:
with s as (
  select id, started, data,
    (select min((elem->>'at')::double precision) from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(data->'stages', '[]'::jsonb)) elem where elem ? 'at') as first_at,
    (select (elem->>'at')::double precision from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(data->'stages', '[]'::jsonb)) elem where elem->>'stage' = 'planned' and elem ? 'at' limit 1) as planned_at,
    (select max((elem->>'at')::double precision) from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(data->'stages', '[]'::jsonb)) elem where elem->>'stage' = 'verified' and elem ? 'at') as last_verified_at,
    (select (elem->>'at')::double precision from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(data->'stages', '[]'::jsonb)) elem where elem->>'stage' = 'done' and elem ? 'at' limit 1) as done_at
  from public.analyses
  where $__timeFilter(started)
)
select $__timeGroup(started, '1d') as time,
  avg(greatest(planned_at - first_at, 0)) / 60.0 as "reading (approx.)",
  avg(greatest(last_verified_at - planned_at, 0)) / 60.0 as "source prep + judging (approx.)",
  avg(greatest(done_at - last_verified_at, 0)) / 60.0 as "finishing (approx.)"
from s
where first_at is not null and planned_at is not null
group by 1
order by 1

select $__timeGroup(a.started, '1d') as time,
  coalesce(v->>'verdict', 'none') as verdict,
  count(*) as count
from public.analyses a,
  lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(a.data->'claims', '[]'::jsonb)) c,
  lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(c->'verdicts', '[]'::jsonb)) v
where $__timeFilter(a.started)
group by 1, 2
order by 1

with counts as (
  select a.id,
    count(v) as n_checks
  from public.analyses a
  left join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(a.data->'claims', '[]'::jsonb)) c on true
  left join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(c->'verdicts', '[]'::jsonb)) v on true
  where $__timeFilter(a.started)
  group by a.id
)
select avg(n_checks) as avg_checks_per_analysis from counts

panels.title: Share of checks with no verdict

targets.rawSql:
with counts as (
  select a.id,
    count(v) as n_checks,
    count(*) filter (where v is not null and v->>'verdict' is null) as n_no_verdict
  from public.analyses a
  left join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(a.data->'claims', '[]'::jsonb)) c on true
  left join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(c->'verdicts', '[]'::jsonb)) v on true
  where $__timeFilter(a.started)
  group by a.id
)
select case when sum(n_checks) = 0 then null else sum(n_no_verdict)::float8 / sum(n_checks) end as share_no_verdict from counts

panels.title: Uploads vs identifiers per day
panels.description: upload = analyses.data.paper starts with "data/papers/"; identifier = arXiv id, DOI, or URL.

targets.rawSql:
select $__timeGroup(started, '1d') as time,
  case when data->>'paper' like 'data/papers/%' then 'upload' else 'identifier' end as kind,
  count(*) as count
from public.analyses
where $__timeFilter(started)
group by 1, 2
order by 1

panels.title: Active users per day
panels.description: Distinct owners with an analysis started that day. Counts only — never shows an owner id.

targets.rawSql:
select $__timeGroup(started, '1d') as time,
  count(distinct data->>'owner') as active_users
from public.analyses
where $__timeFilter(started) and data->>'owner' is not null
group by 1
order by 1

panels.title: Running now
panels.description: id, minutes since start, last stage. No titles or owners.

targets.rawSql:
select id,
  extract(epoch from (now() - started)) / 60.0 as minutes_since_start,
  data->'stages'->-1->>'stage' as last_stage
from public.analyses
where data->>'status' = 'running'
order by started asc
